blocks.html: Karolina Łagodzka-Dubikowska has over 6 years of professional experience. She is a People Senior Partner at VirtusLab and a cognitive behavioural psychotherapist. With a rich background in both domains and Master's Degrees in Psychology and Social Change Management, she possesses a unique perspective on human aspects in business settings and a deep understanding of the psychological aspects influencing professional growth. In my free time, I find joy in sailing and dancing.
